calculation.description: Ranks 15 tradable assets by volatility-normalized 20-session reversal relative to the equal-weight universe, with stronger scores for assets having lower trailing 80-session sensitivity to VIX returns. All inputs are lagged through the prior completed session.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC/ICIR: 2020-2024 +0.005261/+0.014774 (weak but positive); 2025-2027 +0.037117/+0.120193; 2028-2029 +0.043416/+0.157613; 2030-07-21 +0.059096/+0.219043. Small cross-section implies conservative interpretation of uncertainty.
